facts.text: John received a promotion and was awarded a golden trophy as a symbol of his journey and achievements.

evidence.quote: I was really excited. It feels like all the hard work I've put in has paid off now that I'm an assistant manager- it's like a stepping stone for bigger things. [image: a photography of a golden trophy on a black surface]
It commemorates my journey. It's a symbol of all the obstacles I had to overcome to get here.

facts.text: John mentioned that self-doubt was one of the most challenging obstacles he faced during his journey.

evidence.quote: The worst was self-doubt. There were moments when I questioned if I was on the right track.
I can imagine those hurdles were tough to deal with, especially the self-doubt.

facts.text: John attributed his success to support from home and his own perseverance.

evidence.quote: But with support at home and my own grit, I powered through.
It wasn't easy, but I'm proud of what I achieved. It can be tricky, but having support and believing in myself really helped me out.
